contradictions.what: Rep first says the customer was building a portal, then says the team is four people, isn't building anything, and the portal is off the shelf.
Rep opens by saying the trigger was the portal, then says the portal was an excuse and the real trigger was the new CFO's month-end close.
Rep says the customer's questions changed 'not much' after the bank talk, then describes a new question about a named contact.
Rep says the first proposal stalled for three weeks but later says she lost a month pitching the portal.
Rep rated the deal 'dead' at 20 percent just before the meeting where Ines asked to see the demo on her own data. 'That meeting. Well, the one after' also shifts the moment she felt it was won.
Rep says she learned of the CFO's role by the third call yet says she only lost a month. She also says Paul was her day-to-day and Ines missed the first call.

outcome_signals.what: Deal signed even though the distributor reference request was never met.
Rep says that after the data-based ROI meeting 'it was paperwork'.
